input.change_text: Added `includeSystemMessages` option to `getSessionMessages()` to optionally include system messages in session history

output.subject: includeSystemMessages option on getSessionMessages()
output.action_text: Upgrade to `claude-agent-sdk-typescript` 0.2.89+ to pass `includeSystemMessages: true` to `getSessionMessages()` when you need system messages in the returned history. Default is false; existing callers see no behavior change.
